_note: commodity_code-based categories (separate axis from office_footprint_categories.json, which is description_en-based and has much better field coverage -- see README). Exact GSIN commodity_code values, not blind prefixes -- a bare 4-char prefix like R199 or R123 also covers unrelated multi-billion-dollar contracts, e.g. facilities management and overseas logistics support. The one exception is the N7110* prefix, verified clean (every N7110* code in the GSIN table is an office-furniture item). Kept in sync with CONSULTING_CODES / OFFICE_FOOTPRINT_CODES / OFFICE_FOOTPRINT_PREFIXES in scripts/build_aggregates.py -- edit both together.
